results.title: Voya Financial Issues Advisory to Shareholders Regarding Misleading Statements and Conduct by TOMS Capital Investment Management
results.description: Voya Financial, Inc. (NYSE: VOYA) (the “Company”) is aware of the recent public letter and purported proxy filing from TOMS Capital Investment Management LP and affiliates (“TCIM”). These materials describe a fictitious shareholder meeting in a manner and format that is liable to confuse and deceive our investors.

results.title: Onion, chicken prices make home-cooked meals costlier in July: Report
results.description: Vegetarian thali costs rose four percent year-on-year in July. Non-vegetarian thali prices increased nine percent due to higher chicken costs. Onion and vegetable oil prices also contributed significantly to these increases. Potato and tomato prices fell, partially offsetting the overall rise. Month-on-month, vegetarian thali costs saw a two percent jump.
